zh-CN.title: 广场活动聚合八仙与永久 VIP
items: 广场活动栏按八仙、永久 VIP 的顺序自动轮播，也支持手动切换
已领取用户仍可查看自己的永久 VIP 席位，未领取用户可直接查看条件并认领

en.title: Square brings Baxian and permanent VIP together
items: The campaign rail now auto-rotates from Baxian to permanent VIP, with manual navigation available
Claimed members can revisit their permanent VIP spot, while others can review requirements and claim directly
